systems.system: Projecto Njila, componente III: reabilitação e apetrechamento de postos de registo de nascimento
systems.owner: Ministério da Administração do Território as coordinator; component III under the Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos; World Bank financing of USD 250 million
systems.tiers: birth registration posts: 11 rehabilitated and equipped in Bié in 2025, five of them working since August 2025, mostly in maternal and child health centres; 13 more nearing completion in Huambo; the project covers 53 municipalities in eight provinces

systems.system: campanhas de massificação de registo de nascimento e emissão do BI
systems.owner: Projecto Njila; Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: Huambo municipality, more than 2,500 people in 2025; Cuito (Bié), more than 2,800 people

note: The report gives counts of birth registration posts rehabilitated and equipped and of people reached by campaigns; it does not say how those posts record a birth, so premises and campaigns are noted and no fact is taken.
